en.title: Certain Russian Goods Remission Order (SOR/2023-160): French XML dated 2030-07-08
en.summary: The French XML of the Certain Russian Goods Remission Order (SOR/2023-160) has the point-in-time date (lims:pit-date) 2030-07-08 and the current date 2026-09-03. The English XML has the point-in-time date 2026-06-22.
en.impact: A machine reader that selects versions by date may treat the French version as a version of 2030 or skip it. The text of the order is not affected.
en.correction: The Department of Justice decides how to correct each place in the consolidation or the XML; the evidence gives the wording of each language version.
